name: Information Scent (Sequential Decision Model)
fact: Trial-and-error navigation behavior is explained by information scent when modeled as a sequential decision-making problem under memory constraints.

provenance.title: Modeling Trial-and-Error Navigation With a Sequential Decision Model of Information Scent
provenance.quote_or_locus: We conclude that trial-and-error behavior is well explained by information scent when accounting for the sequential and bounded characteristics of the navigation problem
